sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the omitted location and minimization semantics. Require several distinct horizontal load positions, including a case centered at half the applicable span or spacing, rather than only one midpoint case. Encode the required vertical cases: centered at UIWL, at 0.5h0 below LIWL, and at several distinct intermediate vertical locations. Also require evidence that the selected application locations minimize capacity under combined bending and shear; combinedBendingAndShearEvaluated=true alone does not establish minimization. Locate canonical terms for LIWL, h0, and any needed minimization/location evidence that are absent from the scoped vocabulary.
